description: Pinned episode set for the entity-linking eval (spec #81, the cutover gate). Pass to `thestill eval run --rubric entity-linking --episodes-file`. 20 episodes across 20 podcasts, picked from PRODUCTION on 2026-09-21: two Croatian, one known ambiguity trap, a dozen 2026 AI/tech episodes where ReFinED is weakest, and four episodes where it is strongest, as the regression check. Every episode had 40-160 distinct names decided by ReFinED when pinned. The slugs are production slugs, so the run must read the production database. Do not rotate members casually: comparisons across linker versions assume the same inputs.
